ad_library.summary: Rayzon Solar is running 1 active Meta ad, started 13 October 2026. The creative is scheme-branded ('PM Surya Ghar') and the click goes to an Instagram profile - not rayzonsolar.com - so there is no landing page, no form and no pixel behind the spend. Rayzon is a Surat-based module manufacturer (Rayzon Solar Ltd, Millennium Business Hub, Varachha Road, with factories at Kim and Kosamba) whose site carries the proof stack the ad never shows: 6 GW capacity, ALMM listing, Ecovadis certificate and a 360-degree factory tour. Google Ads Transparency records were not checked in this pass.

funnel.meaning: The click leaves Meta for Instagram - a profile, not a page you can measure or test. There is no landing page, no enquiry form, no pixel and no retargeting pool, so the spend produces profile visits and nothing that can be optimised against a lead.

findings: The single live ad (since 13 Oct 2026) clicks to an Instagram profile - not rayzonsolar.com. No landing page, no enquiry form, no pixel, no retargeting pool.
The copy is scheme-branded ('PM Surya Ghar') with no offer, no number and no call to action. For a manufacturer this may be deliberate brand awareness, but it produces no measurable enquiries.
rayzonsolar.com carries the full proof stack - 6 GW manufacturing capacity, ALMM listing, Ecovadis certificate, 360-degree factory tour - none of which the ad shows.
One ad, one creative, one destination, all cold traffic - there is no second creative to test and no retargeting ad behind it.
Public data cannot show the spend, the audience or the objective behind the ad - those controls are marked unknown in the control review.
next_steps: Point the ad at a page you own
Send the PM Surya Ghar ad to a landing page on rayzonsolar.com with an enquiry form and the Meta Pixel, so the click can be measured and retargeted.
Turn the manufacturer proof into the creative
6 GW capacity, ALMM listing and the Ecovadis certificate are stronger differentiators than a scheme logo - they are already on the site, just not in the ad.
Add a second creative to test
A distributor / EPC-facing angle tested against the PM Surya Ghar angle tells you which audience the spend is actually reaching.
Decide what the ad is for
If the objective is enquiries, the Instagram destination cannot deliver them; if it is awareness, the objective and reporting need to be set that way in the account.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
